name: Twisted Tools
summary: A smith asks you to study weapons carried by Blackthorne cultists. Their marks may reveal how the cult’s corruption spreads.

sections.title: The Smith’s Concern
sections.body: A smith who has worked iron all his life sees Blackthorne cultists turning weapons toward harm of the land and flesh. He asks you to bring back a ritual dagger and a staff so their corrupting marks can be studied.

sections.title: A Dark Burden
sections.body: The weapons carry a darkness that clings to you while you bear them. The smith takes them from you and hopes, with the Earthmother’s blessing, to find a way to reverse their corruption.

faq.answer: The smith asks you to bring back a ritual dagger and a staff carried by Blackthorne cultists.
The smith hopes the marks on the weapons will show how the cult’s corruption spreads and how it might be stopped or reversed.
The weapons named are a Wicked Ritualist’s Kris and a Recoiling Gnarlybark Staff.
The smith senses a darkness about you while you carry the weapons and warns that their effects from handling are not yet known.
